Class AmwpFacade.OpenFuture

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpFacade.OpenFuture
All Implemented Interfaces:
Future<Object>
Enclosing class:
AmwpFacade
private static final class AmwpFacade.OpenFuture extends Object implements Future<Object>
The OpenFuture class is the in-flight placeholder before submit. The future is not done until it is cancelled.
